# Setup Python

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-docs.mjs. Edit the manifest, then run `make docs`. -->

Set up Python with uv (or pip), caching, and a dependency install

```yaml
- uses: patrickisgreat/actions-toolkit/actions/setup-python@v1
```

## How it works

Python toolchain setup, uv-first, with a dependency install.

`uv` is the default because it is an order of magnitude faster than pip in CI and
resolves from whatever the project already has (uv.lock, pyproject.toml, or a plain
requirements.txt). Set `installer: pip` for projects that aren't ready to move.

When `uv.lock` is present the install is locked and reproducible (`uv sync --frozen`),
which is the Python analogue of `--frozen-lockfile`. Dependabot gets the same relaxed
treatment as in setup-node, for the same reason.

## Inputs

| Input | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `python-version` | no | `3.12` | Python version. Empty defers to `.python-version` / `pyproject.toml`. |
| `installer` | no | `uv` | uv \| pip |
| `uv-version` | no | `""` | uv version to install. Empty means latest. |
| `install` | no | `true` | true to install dependencies after setup. |
| `groups` | no | `--all-extras --dev` | Dependency groups/extras to include, e.g. `--group dev --extra ml`. uv only. |
| `requirements` | no | `requirements.txt` | Requirements file for the pip installer, or when no pyproject.toml exists. |
| `frozen-lockfile` | no | `auto` | auto \| true \| false. `auto` means strict, except on Dependabot PRs. |
| `working-directory` | no | `.` | Directory to run in. |
| `cache` | no | `true` | true to cache the resolver/download cache. |

## Outputs

| Output | Description |
|---|---|
| `python-version` | The Python version actually installed. |
| `installer` | The resolved installer (`uv` or `pip`). |
| `venv` | Path to the virtualenv uv created, if any. |
